title: The Children of the New Forest
text: You are here highly spoken of, said the prince, for so young a man. So you were at the affair of Worcester? We will retain you, for your services will be wanted by-and-by.

title: Aunt Jane's Nieces on Vacation
text: West glanced along the street--up one side and down the other--and then shook his head negatively. Plenty of land, but no buildings, said he. You might buy the old mill and turn it into a newspaper office.
